description: On the tabletop there’s a small cardboard box near the back, a small cube block and a white duck-like toy near the middle, and a yellow lemon-shaped object on the right. The right hand reaches in from the right to grab the yellow lemon-shaped item and tosses it upward toward the center, then moves in to pick up the small cube block and immediately shifts to grasp the white duck-like toy, lifting it off the table and carrying it out of view.
